column1: # Zig definition rule. Recorded at file level and inside struct/enum/union: a const or var whose
# value is a struct/enum/union/opaque or an error set (class); a const that is a builtin type, a
# function type, or a TitleCase name bound to a name, field access or call (type_alias); any other
# const (constant) and any var, also threadlocal (variable). Functions (function, or method inside a
# struct/enum/union); struct and union fields (field); enum variants (constant); string-named
# test blocks (function, named by the string).
# A container written as the type of a local variable, or inside a function body, keeps no members
# (a function there is a function, build.zig 43). Not recorded: @import bindings and "const Self = @This()", locals (declarations in a function
# body), error set members, "test name {}" doc tests, comptime blocks.
# A file that is itself a struct (const Self = @This();) declares its fields at file level: each is a field (Store.zig).
